# Godhans Tree Company

> Veteran-owned and disabled-veteran-owned tree service in Jacksonville, NC, serving all of Onslow County since 2013 — 3,500+ jobs. Tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, 24/7 emergency and storm response. $2M general liability with every machine individually insured; certificates on request. NC does not license tree contractors — we publish real pricing and insurance proof instead. Free estimates, military discount.

## Start here
- [Godhans Tree Company — Jacksonville, NC](https://godhans.com/): Homepage. Veteran-owned tree service covering Jacksonville and all of Onslow County; removal, trimming, stump grinding, 24/7 emergency and storm response.
- [About — Michael Godbersen and James Godbersen](https://godhans.com/about): The owners. Brothers and USMC veterans; Michael Godbersen owns the company and handles high-risk technical removals and climbing, James Godbersen is co-owner and runs ground operations and heavy equipment.

## People
- **Michael Godbersen** — Owner of Godhans Tree Company and the sole author of this site's content. High-risk technical removals and tree climbing; also storm damage assessment and hazardous tree removal. USMC veteran. Profile: https://godhans.com/about
- **James Godbersen** — Co-Owner, Michael's brother. Heavy equipment operation and ground operations. USMC veteran. Profile: https://godhans.com/about

## Pricing
- [Tree Removal Cost in North Carolina (2026 Guide)](https://godhans.com/tree-removal-cost-north-carolina): Real ranges: $800 minimum, most jobs $1,500–$3,500; size and access bands; coastal NC and Onslow County sections.
- [Stump Grinding in Jacksonville, NC](https://godhans.com/stump-grinding-jacksonville-nc): $200 minimum, $6/inch at the root flare, 10+ inch grind depth, full excavation from $800.

## Services
- [Tree Removal](https://godhans.com/tree-removal-jacksonville-nc): Removal with resistograph decay testing; pine and sweetgum specifics; near-house and tight-access work.
- [Tree Trimming](https://godhans.com/tree-trimming-jacksonville-nc): Structural pruning off rooflines and power lines; oak preservation via epicormic growth.
- [Emergency Tree Service](https://godhans.com/emergency-tree-service-jacksonville-nc): 24/7 response; hazardous tree removal.
- [Storm Cleanup](https://godhans.com/storm-cleanup-jacksonville-nc): Hurricane and storm debris, leaning-tree risk checks.
- [Commercial Tree Service](https://godhans.com/commercial-tree-service-jacksonville-nc): HOAs and property managers; COI for vendor onboarding; maintenance contracts.
- [Residential Tree Service](https://godhans.com/residential-tree-service-jacksonville-nc): Homeowner-focused; the $800 minimum explained; what an estimate should include.
- [Debris Hauling](https://godhans.com/debris-hauling-jacksonville-nc): Organic debris only (trees, brush, leaves). $800 minimum, about $400 per dump trailer; roughly two trailers covered by the minimum within ~5 miles of the shop.
- [Resistograph Tree Testing](https://godhans.com/resistograph-tree-testing-jacksonville-nc): Measures internal decay in a standing trunk so sound hardwoods are not removed on a guess. Local species patterns; lightning-struck pines.
